annotations.text:
DAEMUN III — design direction

Dark navy hero + warm paper body. Blue #0C4884 is sampled straight from your logo; the emblem is knocked out to transparent from Logo Black.png (the white JPG has a Hypic watermark, so I avoided it).

Type: Instrument Serif for display, Instrument Sans for text.
Gold #C9A968 is the accent — the 'voice' half of the theme.

Gold dashed boxes = things only you can fill in.

On the Secretariat page the photos and names are real, from your roster — but every POSITION and GREETING is a placeholder. I don't know who holds which role, so nothing there is an assignment. Romanised names are my best guess; correct them in place.

The two September pages.

Committees: the ECOSOC / UNOOSA tabs actually work — click them. Everything else is a static mockup.

Resolutions: the approval panel shows all three states (approved / under review / awaiting) so you can see how each looks. Those are sample states, not real submissions.
